summary.headline: 1 of 28 random charts below billed level
summary.rationale: 1000000107 billed 99215 on 12.5% of 695 claims against an expected 4.8% given patient complexity (risk-adjusted score 3.58; plain z-score vs peers 0.80). 38% of this provider's 99215 claims were on patients with 0 or 1 chronic conditions. Records came back for 28 claims. Of 2 documented 99215 claims, 0 (0%) were documented below the billed level, against 45% for the comparison providers. Note checks on 28 returned notes (share showing each sign): problems 32%, late 14%, unsigned 0%, data 14%. No audit trail was received. 4 of 18 notes claiming moderate-or-higher data reviewed had no lab or test line on the claim. 99215 share is 2.61x expected, but in the random sample only 1 of 28 charts was documented below the billed level. Late signing was 14% over 28 notes, a cloning sign, but the rules did not find the notes inflated. Inconclusive. Examples: C0048032: billed 99214; documented MDM level low, 25 minutes. C0047820: billed 99215, patient aged 39 with 0 chronic condition(s). C0047887: billed 99215, patient aged 49 with 1 chronic condition(s) (osteoarthritis).
next_steps: 28 charts came back but do not settle it: request a targeted sample of 99215 charts, starting with C0048032, C0047820, C0047887.
Re-check after the targeted charts arrive; do not call upcoding or a sicker panel on this evidence alone.
